name: Great Burkhan Khaldun Mountain and its surrounding sacred landscape
description: Burkhan Khaldun is a forested peak in the Khentii Mountains of north-eastern Mongolia, where open Central Asian steppe gives way to Siberian taiga. Often called Mongolia's most sacred mountain, it is believed to be where Genghis Khan was born and buried. Pilgrims still honour it with rock cairns called ovoo, in rituals that blend shamanic and Buddhist traditions.
